segments.name: Payments
segments.description: Operates a digital payments platform in North America that extends consumers point-of-sale installment credit and subscription services.
segments.evidence: Our Chief Executive Officer is considered to be the CODM, and our operations comprise one reportable segment, primarily deriving revenue from our payment processing platform in North America.

revenueModel.text: The company derives revenue from its payment processing platform, charging merchants for payment processing and consumers fees, interest, and recurring subscription charges.
revenueModel.evidence: The "pay-in-four" product may be free or subject to fees and/or interest.

changes.text: In recent years the company has been winding down and exiting operations in India and certain countries in Europe.
changes.evidence: We operate in the United States and Canada, and are currently winding down and exiting operations in India and certain countries in Europe.
